title: SPEAK THE BLESSINGS OF GOD INTO YOUR DECEMBER
text: Beloved, I want you to stand on your feet wherever you are. I want you to lift up your hands right now because the spirit of the living God is in this atmosphere. And I sense in my spirit that there are men and women, sons and daughters of the kingdom, who have been through the travail of 11 months. You have been through the fire. You have been through the wilderness. You have walked through valleys where shadows were thick. And now we are standing at the threshold of December. And the Lord is saying, "Open your mouth and speak my blessings into this season." I need you to understand something that is critical to your advancement in the kingdom. The Bible makes it clear in the book of Proverbs chapter 18 and verse 21 that death and life are in the power of the tongue and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. You see, your mouth is not just an instrument for eating and drinking. Your mouth is a prophetic gateway. Your mouth is a spiritual portal through which the realities of heaven are birthed into the earth. And I have come to announce to you by the authority of the spirit of God that December will not pass you by without the manifestation of the glory that has been assigned to your life. The scripture says in the book of Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." The word decree in the Hebrew is the word gaz, which means to cut, to divide, to determine by a prophetic utterance. This tells me that there is a dimension of authority that God has given to the sons of men, particularly to those who are in covenant with him, where you can stand in your position as a royal priesthood, as a chosen generation, and you can cut to the barriers of the spirit realm with the declarations that proceed from your mouth. Now, I want you to understand that we are not just making positive confessions. This is not the psychology of positive thinking. This is not motivational speaking. This is a theocratic operation where the government of heaven is being established through the voice of the redeemed. When you speak the blessings of God into your December, you are not hoping, you are not wishing, you are not crossing your fingers, you are legislating from the position that Christ has given you. Ephesians chapter 2:6 says that he has raised us up together and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. This means that your position is not on the earth struggling. Your position is in the heavenlies ruling. I want to talk to those who have had 11 months of delay. I want to talk to those who have had 11 months where it seemed like every door you knocked on was shut. I want to talk to those who have swn seed after seed and it looks like there is no harvest. I want to talk to those who have prayed prayer after prayer and the heavens seem like brass. The spirit of the Lord asked me to tell you that December is your season of the suddenly of God. The Bible tells us about a certain woman in the Gospel of Luke chapter 13, a woman who had been bound by a spirit of infirmity for 18 years. 18 years. And the Bible says that Jesus saw her and called her forth and said, "Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity." After 18 years of bondage, in one moment, in one divine encounter, everything changed. There are some of you, December is not going to be business as usual. December is going to be the month where heaven arrests your situation. December is going to be the month where the finger of God writes your name in the book of remembrance for blessing. The Bible says in Malachi chapter 3 that there is a book of remembrance that is written for them that fear the Lord and that think upon his name. And when your name is in that book, you become a candidate for the suddenly of God. You become a candidate for unusual favor. You become a candidate for uncommon breakthroughs. Now let me show you something from the scriptures that will help you understand the power of speaking blessings. In the book of Genesis chapter 1, the Bible records for us the creation narrative. And if you study that passage carefully, you will notice a pattern. God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. God said, "Let there be a firmament." And it was so. God said, "Let the earth bring forth." and the earth brought forth. Everything that God created came into existence by the instrumentality of words. The writer of Hebrews understood this mystery and that is why in Hebrews chapter 11:3 he says through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear. This is telling you and me that the visible realm is subject to the invisible realm. The physical realm is subject to the spiritual realm. And the spiritual realm is accessed and activated by words. Not just any words, but words that are pregnant with faith. Words that are dipped in the anointing. Words that are soaked in the covenant promises of God. So when you open your mouth in December and you begin to declare the blessings of the Lord, you are not just speaking into the air, you are releasing spiritual seeds into the womb of time. And those seeds must produce after their kind. I need to emphasize something that many believers miss. You see, there is a difference between prayer and declaration. Prayer is you talking to God about your situation. Declaration is you talking to your situation about your God. Both are important. But many believers are stuck in the realm of prayer and they have not crossed over into the dimension of declaration. The Bible says in Mark 11:23, "For verily I say unto you that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith." Notice that Jesus didn't say whosoever shall pray about this mountain. He said whosoever shall say unto this mountain. There is a dimension of authority where you are not begging the mountain to move. You are commanding it to move. You are not asking the mountain if it will relocate. You are legislating its relocation. And December is the month where you must shift from petition to proclamation. You must shift from asking to announcing. You must shift from requesting to requiring. The spirit of God wants me to tell somebody that the delays you have experienced were not denials. The delays were divine setups for a greater glory. The Bible tells us about a man called Lazarus in the Gospel of John 11. When Lazarus was sick, his sister sent word to Jesus saying, "Lord, he whom you love is sick." The Bible records that Jesus deliberately stayed where he was for two more days. Why? Because if he had come when they first called him, it would have been a healing. But because he waited until Lazarus died and was buried for 4 days, it became a resurrection. Sometimes God delays your answer because he wants to upgrade it from healing to resurrection, from breakthrough to overflow, from victory to dominance. Now, let me give you a prophetic insight about the month of December. December is the 12th month of the year. And in biblical numerology, the number 12 represents divine government, divine order, and apostolic completeness. There were 12 tribes of Israel. There were 12 apostles. The new Jerusalem has 12 gates and 12 foundations. When you enter into December, you are entering into a season that carries the anointing of governmental authority. This is the season where God establishes his order in your life. This is the season where loose ends are tied up. This is the season where what has been scattered is gathered. This is the season where what has been fragmented is made whole. I want you to open your mouth right now and begin to declare, December, you are my month of governmental authority. December, you are my month of divine order. Every area of my life that has been in chaos, I decree alignment in the name of Jesus. Every area of my finances that has been in disorder, I decree divine organization. Every area of my health that has been in confusion, I decree supernatural restoration. Every relationship that has been broken, I decree divine reconciliation and healing. You see, when you speak the blessings of God into your December, you are not manufacturing reality. You are unveiling reality. You are not creating something out of nothing. You are calling those things that be not as though they were, which is the faith of Abraham according to Romans 4:1 17. God has already prepared blessings for you. Ephesians 1:3 says that he has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ. Notice the tense. He has blessed us. Not he will bless us. Not he might bless us. He has blessed us. The blessings are already in the vault of heaven. Your responsibility is to call them forth, to speak them into manifestation, to decree them into your timeline. Let me tell you about a dimension of blessing that many believers are ignorant of. In the book of Deuteronomy chapter 28, God outlined blessings for obedience. But if you read that passage carefully, you will notice that the blessings are not passive. They are aggressive. Verse two says, "And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee, if thou shalt harken unto the voice of the Lord thy God." The word overtake means to pursue, to chase down, to hunt. This tells me that when you are in covenant with God and you are walking in obedience to his voice, blessings don't just come to you slowly. They chase you. They pursue you. They overtake you. You cannot run fast enough to escape the blessings of God when you are in his divine will. But here is the key. You must hearken to the voice of the Lord your God. Harkening is not just hearing. It is obeying. It is alignment. It is submission to the divine instruction. And when you align yourself with the voice of God, you position yourself in the pathway where the blessings are programmed to flow. So as you enter December, ask yourself, what is God saying? What is the prophetic instruction for this season? What is the divine wisdom that will unlock the treasures that have been stored up for me? I sense in my spirit that there are entrepreneurs, businessmen and women who are hearing me right now. And the Lord is saying that December is your month of unusual deals. December is your month where contracts that have been delayed will suddenly be signed. December is your month where investors who have been hesitant will suddenly become convinced. December is your month where ideas that have been in your heart will suddenly find expression and manifestation. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 11:1, "Cast thy bread upon the waters, for thou shalt find it after many days." Some of you have been casting your bread. You have been sewing your seeds. You have been investing your time, your talent, your treasure and it looks like there is no return. But God says after many days, December is your after many days season. For some of you who are students who are in academic pursuit, the Lord showed me that December is your month of academic excellence. December is your month where understanding that has been difficult will suddenly become clear. December is your month where examinations that seemed impossible will suddenly become testimonies. The Bible talks about Daniel, a young man who was in a foreign land. And the scripture says in Daniel 1:1 17 that God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom. And Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams. When you are a child of God, you have access to a dimension of wisdom that is not natural. It is supernatural. And I decree that in this December, the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him will rest upon you according to Ephesians 1:17. Now let me talk to those who are believing God for marital settlement. The Lord asked me to tell you that December is a season of divine connections. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:22, "Who so findeth a wife findeth a good thing and obtainth favor of the Lord." Notice that finding a wife is connected to obtaining favor. This tells me that marriage is not just a social arrangement. It is a divine favor. It is a blessing from the throne of God. And when God is ready to settle you maritalally, he will orchestrate divine encounters that you could never have planned with human wisdom. I remember the story of Isaac in Genesis chapter 24. Abraham sent his servant to find a wife for Isaac. And the servant prayed a very specific prayer. He said, "Let it come to pass that the damel to whom I shall say, let down thy picture, I pray thee, that I may drink, and she shall say, drink, and I will give thy camels drink also. Let the same be she that thou has appointed for thy servant Isaac." And before he had finished speaking, the Bible says, Rebecca came out. before he finished praying, the answer was already on the way. This is the dimension of speed that God wants to introduce into your life in December. The answer is already in motion before you finish articulating the question. I want to declare over your life right now, every divine connection that is meant to bring you into your destiny, I decree that in December, you will encounter them. Every relationship that is meant to elevate you, every partnership that is meant to prosper you, every alliance that is meant to advance you, I call them forth in the name of Jesus. And I decree that wrong connections, toxic relationships, destiny killers, and time wasters will be exposed and removed from your path in this season. Let me also speak to those who are standing in faith for healing and restoration in their bodies. The Bible tells us about a woman in Mark chapter 5 who had an issue of blood for 12 years. 12 years she had spent all that she had on physicians and instead of getting better she grew worse. But one day she heard about Jesus. And the Bible says she said within herself, "If I may but touch his garment, I shall behold." Notice that she spoke to herself before she experienced the miracle. She programmed her mind with the word of faith. She declared her healing before she received her healing. And when she touched the hem of his garment, virtue went out of Jesus and she was made whole. The spirit of God wants me to tell you that December is your month of supernatural healing. December is your month where chronic conditions will bow to the name of Jesus. December is your month where medical reports will be rewritten by the power of God. I don't care how long you have been carrying that sickness. I don't care what the doctors have said. I don't care how many treatments have failed. The Bible says in Jeremiah 32 27, "Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?" And the answer is a resounding no. There is nothing too hard for our God. Open your mouth and begin to speak life into your body. Begin to speak strength into your bones. Begin to speak health into your organs. The Bible says in Proverbs 4:22 that God's words are life unto those that find them and health to all their flesh. When you speak the word of God over your body, you are not just reciting verses. You are releasing medicine. You are releasing healing virtue. You are releasing resurrection power. I decree that every cell in your body will respond to the word of God. I decree that every organ will come into divine alignment. I decree that pain will cease, that tumors will dissolve, that diseases will flee, and that your body will come into perfect health in the name of Jesus. Now, let me address something that is very critical. Some of you have been speaking blessings, but you have been contradicting your declarations with your conversations. You pray in the morning and declare blessings but by afternoon you are complaining about how difficult things are. You prophesy breakthrough but in your casual discussions you are rehearsing the problem. The Bible warns us in the book of Matthew 12:37. For by thy words thou shalt be justified and by thy words thou shalt be condemned. This tells me that words are not neutral. They are either working for you or against you. They are either building your future or demolishing it. I need you to take inventory of your conversations in this December. What have you been saying about your situation? What have you been saying about your finances? What have you been saying about your future? The Bible says in Numbers chapter 14 that when the children of Israel murmured and complained, saying, "Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt, God said to them, as truly as I live, sayeth the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you." Their words became their prophecy. Their complaints became their destiny. And many believers today are living in the fulfillment of their negative confessions. But I have good news for you. The Bible says in Joel chapter 3:10, "Let the weak say I am strong." Notice that it doesn't say, "Let the weak complain about how weak they are." It says, "Let the weak say I am strong." Even when your bank account is saying you are broke, you say, "I am blessed." Even when your body is saying you are sick, you say I am healed. Even when circumstances are saying you are defeated, you say I am more than a conqueror through Christ that loves me. This is not denial of reality. This is declaration of a higher reality. This is speaking from the realm of faith instead of from the realm of sight. Let me prophesy to some families that are represented here. The Lord showed me that there are families that have been experiencing cycles of poverty, cycles of sickness, cycles of failure. Generation after generation, it has been the same story. But the spirit of the Lord says that December is the month where generational cycles are broken. December is the month where new family histories are written. December is the month where instead of being the tail, you become the head. The Bible talks about Abraham in Genesis 12. And God said to him, "I will bless thee and make thy name great, and thou shalt be a blessing." Abraham came from a family of idol worshippers, but God transformed his destiny and made him the father of faith for all generations. I decree over your family right now, every negative pattern is broken, every cycle of poverty is destroyed, every tradition of failure is abolished, every generational cause is nullified by the blood of Jesus. And I declare that you are the beginning of a new generation of blessing in your family. Your children will not struggle the way you struggled. Your grandchildren will not suffer the way your parents suffered. You are the turning point. You are the gamecher. You are the covenant carrier who will shift your family from obscurity to prominence, from poverty to prosperity, from sickness to health. I want to talk about the blessing of favor for a moment. Favor is one of the most powerful forces in the kingdom of God. The Bible says in Psalm 5:12, "For thou, Lord, will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield." The word compass means to surround, to encircle completely. When the favor of God is upon your life, it surrounds you like a shield. It protects you. It promotes you. It positions you. Favor will make you excel where others fail. Favor will open doors that qualifications cannot open. Favor will take you to places that hard work alone cannot reach. The Bible tells us about Esther, a young Jewish girl who became queen in a foreign land. How did it happen? The scripture says in Esther 2:17, "And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favor in his sight more than all the virgins, so that he set the royal crown upon her head and made her queen instead of Vashi." It was favor. It was grace. It was the hand of God orchestrating events to position her for purpose. And I prophesy to you that in this December, unusual favor will locate you. People who have never noticed you will suddenly begin to pay attention. Organizations that have overlooked you will suddenly begin to reach out. Opportunities that have passed you by will suddenly circle back and find you. Open your mouth and begin to decree, I am a candidate for divine favor. Everywhere I go, I obtain favor. Favor surrounds me like a shield. Favor goes before me and makes crooked places straight. Favor opens doors that no man can shut. Favor positions me in the right place at the right time for the right opportunities. I have favor with God and favor with man. Uncommon favor, unusual favor, unprecedented favor. I receive it in the name of Jesus. Now, let me give you a practical key about speaking blessings. You must be specific. Many believers speak in generalities and they receive general results. But when you are specific in your declarations, you activate specific angelic activity. The Bible talks about angels in Hebrews 1:14, calling them ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. Angels respond to the word of God. Psalm 103:20 says, "Bless the Lord, yay, his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." When you speak the word of God specifically over your situation, angels are assigned to bring it to pass. So don't just say, "I will be blessed in December." Be specific. Say in December I received the contract for that property development. Say in December I received the admission letter from that university. Say in December I received the job offer from that company. Say in December my spouse and I experience a new dimension of love and unity. Say in December, my children excel in their examinations. The more specific you are, the more focused your faith becomes and the more targeted the angelic assignment. I sense that I need to address the issue of patience and expectation. Some of you have been declaring blessings, but you have not been watching for the manifestation. The Bible says in Habacookap 2:1, "I will stand upon my watch and set me upon the tower and will watch to see what he will say unto me." The prophet understood that after you speak, you must watch. After you decree, you must expect. Faith without expectation is dead. You don't just throw words into the atmosphere and then go about your business as if nothing happened. You watch for the fulfillment. You position yourself to receive. In December, I want you to cultivate an expectation that is so strong that when blessings begin to manifest, you are not surprised. You say, "I was expecting this." When opportunities show up, you don't say, "I can't believe this is happening." You say, "I knew this was coming." This is the posture of faith. This is the mentality of a kingdom citizen. You live in anticipation of the goodness of God. The Bible says in Psalm 27:3, "I had fainted unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living." Your expectation keeps you alive. Your anticipation keeps you strong. Your conviction that God is working on your behalf keeps you moving forward. Father, for those who have been waiting for financial breakthrough, we speak release from the windows of heaven. For those who have been standing in faith for healing, we speak life into their bodies. We command every sickness to bow. We command every disease to flee. We declare THAT BY THE STRIPES OF JESUS, they are healed. We speak strength into weak bodies. We speak restoration into damaged organs. We speak wholeness into fragmented minds. For those who are believing for marital settlement, we decree divine connections. We declare that before this December is over, strategic encounters will happen. Doors of relationship will open. Divine orchestration will take place. and we cancel every spirit of delay, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of wrong connection. We declare that only divinely ordained relationships will come to pass for students and those in academic pursuit. We release the spirit of wisdom and revelation. Let understanding be quickened. Let me be sharpened. Let knowledge be increased. We decree excellence in examinations. We decree favor with instructors and authorities for business people and entrepreneurs. We decree unusual deals in December. We decree that contracts will be signed. We decree that investors will come forth. We decree that ideas will find expression. We decree that businesses will expand. We decree that markets will open. We decree that sales will increase. We speak multiplication over every business endeavor. Father, we come against every work of the enemy. We destroy the plans of the devil over every life that is represented here. We nullify every evil covenant. We cancel every satanic verdict. We dismantle every demonic structure. We pull down every stronghold. And we declare that the gates of hell shall not prevail against the church of Jesus Christ. We decree that December is a month of testimonies. December is a month of celebration. December is a month of the manifestation of the glory of God. We decree that joy unspeakable and full of glory will fill every heart. We decree that peace that passes understanding will guard every mind. We decree that strength will be renewed like the eagles. We decree that hope will be restored where it has been lost. And Father, we commit ourselves to being good stewards of the blessings that you are releasing in December. We will not waste them. We will not squander them. We will use them for your glory, for the advancement of your kingdom, and for the blessing of others. Let your name be glorified in our lives. Let your name be exalted through our testimonies. Let your name be magnified in all the earth. We pray all these things in the mighty powerful matchless name of Jesus Christ. The name that is above every name. The name before which every knee must bow and every tongue must confess that he is Lord. Amen and amen. Now receive it by faith. December is yours. The blessings are yours. The breakthroughs are yours. The testimonies are yours. Open your mouth daily and declare it. Write it down. Meditate on it. Believe it. Expect it. And watch as the hand of God moves in your life in ways that will leave you amazed, astonished, and eternally grateful. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace in Jesus mighty name. Amen.
